title: 1976 Topps - #163 Norm Snead
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1976 Topps sports trading card features Norm Snead, the former quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the vintage stock set and is numbered 163 in the base set. It is a great addition to any football or sports trading card collection. 

The card was manufactured by Topps and is in excellent condition. It is a must-have for any football fan or collector interested in the history of the NFL. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare piece of sports memorabilia.
